title: Implement blue-green rollback orchestrator and safe DB checkpoints for private upgrades
author: Marina Alvarez
release_notes: Add blue/green upgrade orchestrator to private installer with transactional DB checkpoint support, Helm hooks for safe cutover, and Terraform locking for state + backup resources. Included runbook and e2e smoke tests.
description:
Context and motivation: We observed two incidents where in-place private upgrades partially applied schema migrations and left clusters in an inconsistent state when failures happened mid-upgrade. Existing rollback relied on restoring full snapshots which is slow and error-prone for large on-prem datasets. This change implements a blue/green upgrade orchestrator for the private installer that creates application-consistent DB checkpoints and performs an atomic cutover between environments to enable fast, low-risk rollback.
Implementation summary: - installer/controller: add a new UpgradeOrchestrator CR workflow (stateless controller in the private installer operator) that drives blue/green lifecycle: preflight -> backup checkpoint -> apply changes to green -> verify -> traffic switch -> decommission old (with optional quarantine). Orchestrator uses tenant-aware fencing to avoid cross-tenant impact and records checkpoints with timestamped IDs. - DB checkpointing: introduce transactional checkpoint step for Postgres-based deployments using pg_start_backup/pg_stop_backup + coordinated WAL archival to S3/GCS-compatible buckets, plus an optional pglogical consistent snapshot path for multi-node clusters. For air-gapped customers we added an offline snapshot export format and a local filesystem staging flow. - Helm changes: add blue-green deployment hooks, pre-upgrade test hooks, configurable `cutoverStrategy` (immediate | canary | manual-confirm) and annotations to opt in per-namespace. The chart now exposes a `checkpointPolicy` that controls retention TTL and verification steps. - Terraform updates: add state_locking and backup_bucket modules, and a lightweight kms_integration optional resource to encrypt exported checkpoints. The terraform module also exposes a `quarantine_tenant` toggle used by the orchestrator. - CLI & docs: private-installer CLI gains `upgrade preview --dry-run` and `rollback to-checkpoint <id>` commands, plus a new runbook in docs/operator/runbooks/bluegreen-upgrade.md. - Tests: added e2e smoke tests that simulate partial-failure during migration and verify rollback behavior; unit tests cover orchestration state transitions and failure retry logic.
Commits (summary): - 1a3f9e5: operator: add UpgradeOrchestrator state machine and API surface - 2b6c0d2: db: implement transactional checkpoint exporter + offline format - 37f9b01: helm: blue-green hooks + cutoverStrategy + checkpointPolicy - 4d0a8b7: terraform: backup_bucket + state_locking + kms optional - 5c2fe14: cli/docs: dry-run/rollback commands + runbook - 6f8e0b3: tests: add e2e partial-failure simulations and unit coverage
Changed areas / high-level file list: - operator/: orchestrator controller, CRD, state machine - db/backup/: checkpoint exporter, WAL helper scripts - charts/private-installer/: templates, hooks, values.yaml additions - terraform/modules/backup_bucket/: new module + examples - cli/: upgrade preview and rollback commands - docs/: new runbook and upgrade guide - tests/e2e/: bluegreen scenarios and test harness
Reviewer conversation (high-level): - Seth Kim (comment, 2025-09-20): "The checkpoint flow looks solid but we need clear failure modes for partial WAL upload failures. Please add retries and documented operator retry policy." - Marina Alvarez (reply, 2025-09-21): "Added exponential backoff retry for WAL uploads and operator-level retry limit with reconciler-visible condition. See db/backup/retry_policy.go" - Anita Rao (request changes, 2025-09-22): "Helm values are powerful but add an escape hatch for air-gapped installs; make export path configurable via values as a filesystem path." - Marina Alvarez (update, 2025-09-23): "Added values.export.path and documented offline export flow in helm/README.md; added e2e test for local export." - Lars Mikkelson (approve, 2025-09-28): "Verified e2e failure injection and rollback within 90s on our test harness; small nits left in docs but not blocking."
CI history summary: - initial CI run: lint & unit: pass; integration/e2e: failed (WAL-upload flakiness) - second run after patch: all checks pass (integration rerun successful)
Rollout / merge notes: - This PR is merged to main via squash on 2025-10-02 after approvals. - Default behavior is opt-in: charts and installer keep blue/green disabled by default; operators must set cutoverStrategy and checkpointPolicy explicitly. - For customers upgrading to a release that includes this orchestrator: instruct to run `private-installer upgrade preview --dry-run` first; if opting in, recommended to set `checkpointPolicy.retentionDays >= 7`.
Rollback playbook (short): - If a migration fails on the green cluster, run `private-installer rollback to-checkpoint <checkpoint-id>` which will: 1) fence tenant traffic, 2) apply checkpoint restore (WAL replay or offline import), 3) re-point service mesh/ingress back to blue, 4) mark green for quarantine and alert SRE.
Related work: ENG-8421 (design doc), ENG-8475 (helm-value gating).
Security notes: - Checkpoints are encrypted at rest when using the terraform kms option; default S3-compatible buckets are private. - Added an audit log entry for `upgrade.start`, `upgrade.checkpoint.create`, `upgrade.cutover`, and `rollback.start`.
Migration compatibility / downgrade guards: - Orchestrator records a manifest hash tied to the installer release; rollback will refuse to restore checkpoints produced by newer major installer versions unless `force-allow-downgrade` is explicitly enabled (audit entry required). This prevents silent incompatibility in schema/manifest formats.
Known limitations and follow-ups: - MySQL connectors are currently out-of-scope; follow-up task added ENG-8609. - Large clusters with multi-TB datasets may still face long WAL upload windows; follow-up to support streaming WAL replication to backup endpoints planned. - UX: add console visualization of orchestrator state (follow-up ENG-8712).
CI / deploy notes for SRE: - Add the new terraform backup_bucket module when creating or upgrading a private deployment to ensure checkpoints have a durable store. - For air-gapped installs, ensure offline export path is writable and cluster has sufficient temporary storage. This PR bundles code, chart, terraform, docs, and tests to make private upgrades safe and fast with an opt-in blue/green model.
notes: This PR intentionally keeps opt-in behavior to limit blast radius; ops required to enable in production. Follow-ups tracked in ENG-8609 and ENG-8712.
